properties.name: Australia
properties.note: National boundary, ADM0: mainland, Tasmania and coastal islands. Source: geoBoundaries gbOpen (wmgeolab/geoBoundaries @ bdfb316), CC0 1.0, simplified to 0.005 degrees (~600 m), which changes the area by 0.005% and cannot change which 20.48 km windows are selected. 7,688,256 km2 across UTM 49 to 56, entirely southern hemisphere. Christmas, Cocos and Norfolk Islands are excluded: 204 km2 between them, but they would stretch the run from UTM 47 to 58 for nothing. An island continent, so the AOI has no land borders and the coastline does all the clipping.
